With a tall and rigid upright branch on the top for placing your angel, this tree is finished with sparkling LED lights all over. Multi-coloured helps create a welcoming and beautiful atmosphere, giving you lots of options to suit your mood and Christmas home furnishings. Perfect for injecting some Christmas joy and spirit into you home this season.
